meta.title: FlowGastronomie — Adaptive technology for gastronomy
meta.description: Specialized digital products for restaurants, pizzerias and modern hospitality businesses on one shared platform.

productFamilies.title: Choose the flow that fits your business.
productFamilies.intro: FlowGastronomie provides the shared account, data and operational core. Each subscription product adds a focused workflow without splitting your business into separate systems.

products.RESTAURANT: Websites, menus, QR and table service, ordering, teams and kitchen/bar operations for restaurants and full-service venues.
products.PIZZERIA: Pizza configuration, fast production and pickup/delivery workflows for pizzerias.
products.BAR: Fast rounds, bar production, table service and a live service view for bars.
products.CAFE: Counter and table workflows, compact menus and repeat service for cafés.
products.IMBISS: Fast ordering, simple production and pickup workflows for snack bars and quick-service venues.
products.DELIVERY: A later delivery-first product for takeaway and delivery operations after the shared order engine is ready.

pricing.title: Start with what your venue needs.
pricing.subtitle: Every plan uses the same menu source. Upgrade when your service needs more automation—without rebuilding your data.
pricing.noCard: No card required. Online payment is not processed during the trial.

hero.title: Technology that adapts to the venue. Not the other way around.
hero.text: Menu, tables and orders in one system. Activate only the modules your team needs—without forcing guests to install an app.

guest.title: Scan. Choose. Send.
guest.intro: No login and no app. The menu opens in the phone language and follows the table's service mode.

features.title: One table. Many guests.
features.text: Table Session brings the table context together while each guest keeps their own basket and, later, their own payment.

features.title: Real availability
features.text: One sold-out action removes the product from every active menu before a guest can order it.

features.title: One menu, every language
features.text: Content is managed once and published across the website, QR menus and selected locations.

radar.title: Not an order list. A radar for service.
radar.text: Signals are ranked by waiting time and the action needed. The team immediately knows where to go.
benefits: A clear status for every table
radar.empty: No table needs attention right now.

pilot.title: One real pilot. One complete flow.
pilot.text: The repository starts with service modes, table sessions, guest ordering and Service Radar. Online payments and fiscal functions come only after the service flow is proven in a venue.
